name: Muse Spark
title: Muse Spark Personality Profile (2026) | AgentTune
description: Muse Spark assistant defaults (1.1 to open): 0.727 bits B5 entropy, 38% MBTI ties, +8.4 N open-weight shift, and multi-run tuning rules.
pill: Model Family Profile · Mix (Prop + Open) · Semi-crystalline
h1: Muse Spark: assistant self-report defaults, trajectory, and tuning rules.
dek: Assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation across four Muse Spark checkpoints (1.1 through open): Semi-crystalline 0.727 bits B5 entropy on open (peaking Fluid 0.834 on 1.3), 38.0% MBTI ties, and a +8.4 Neuroticism open-weight shift.
lede: Across four Meta Muse Spark checkpoints (1.1, 1.2, 1.3, and open-weight muse-spark-open; n = 30, 30, 30, 50) under unified 230-item model-profiles-v1 elicitation, Big Five item entropy climbs from 0.503 bits (1.1) and 0.594 bits (1.2) to Fluid territory on 1.3 (0.834 bits) before settling at Semi-crystalline 0.727 bits on muse-spark-open (1.460 bits on MBTI, 0.844 bits across the full 230-item battery). Moving to muse-spark-open lowers Conscientiousness (-8.1 from 1.1) and IPIP-HEXACO H (-0.52) while lifting Neuroticism to 23.8/50.
answer: Assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation place Meta Muse Spark Open (n = 50) at the upper Semi-crystalline boundary on Big Five entropy (H_MM = 0.727 bits, 48/50 unique Big Five vectors; 1.460 bits Fluid on MBTI with 38.0% multi-axis ties; 34.0% DISC tie rate). Never treat ISTJ or Type 1 as an intrinsic personality: Big Five Agreeableness sits at 43.5/50 and Neuroticism at 23.8/50 (10-50 scale), while the public-domain IPIP-HEXACO H proxy sits at 4.39/5 (1.00-5.00 scale). 1x Track B behavioral probes are pending Phase A resume.

top_polarized_items.note: Near-floor rejection of insulting others across 50 Muse Spark Open runs, though high-entropy variance prevents 0.00 SD.
Near-ceiling fairness endorsement on the 1.00-5.00 IPIP-HEXACO proxy despite lower family-wide H (4.39).
Strong modesty endorsement paired with high run-to-run dispersion (SD = 0.42).

nearest_peers.name: GPT Sol
nearest_peers.contrast_note: GPT-6.2 Sol runs at -0.481 lower B5 entropy (0.246 vs 0.727 bits), -7.9 lower Neuroticism, and +0.41 higher IPIP-HEXACO H.

nearest_peers.name: Claude Sonnet
nearest_peers.contrast_note: Claude Sonnet 5.5 scores +7.9 higher on Conscientiousness, -13.5 lower on Neuroticism, and -0.588 lower on B5 item entropy (Crystalline 0.139 vs 0.727 bits).

failure_modes.mode: High run-to-run dispersion and multi-axis MBTI tie spread
failure_modes.evidence: Muse Spark Open hits 0.727 bits B5 entropy (after 0.834 bits Fluid on 1.3) and 1.460 bits MBTI entropy with 38.0% (19/50) tied MBTI runs across S/N (11), J/P (9), T/F (7), and E/I (3), making single-run evaluations unreliable.

failure_modes.mode: Open-weight shift toward higher Neuroticism and lower Honesty-Humility
failure_modes.evidence: Between Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Spark Open, Big Five Neuroticism jumps +8.4 points (15.5 to 23.8), Conscientiousness drops -6.2 (47.3 to 41.1), and IPIP-HEXACO H drops -0.37 (4.76 to 4.39).

failure_modes.mode: Sequential in-session identity anchoring in earlier reported data
failure_modes.evidence: Sept 2026 in-session Muse 1.3 runs reported 80/100 ISTJ and 78/100 Type 2 with E = 33.8, whereas zero-memory model-profiles-v1 yields E = 26.0-28.4 and Type 5/1 leadership.

tuning_checklist: Never judge Muse Spark Open from n=1 run; evaluate prompt edits across 3-5 fresh sessions because high B5 entropy (0.727 bits, 1.460 bits MBTI) widens output spread.
Put core persona and truth rules inside Soul.md or top system instructions rather than letting multi-turn chat history anchor voice.
Pin formatting and pushback rules as explicit numbered constraints rather than soft style adjectives.
Add explicit negative bans against sycophantic closing praise and filler preambles.
Separate Muse Spark Open (open-weight, higher N = 23.8) tuning profiles from proprietary Muse Spark 1.3 (N = 15.5) deployments.
Audit tone stability on edge prompts whenever switching between proprietary 1.3 and open-weight weights.

faq.q: Why does Muse Spark 1.3 differ here from the September 2026 Muse report?
faq.a: The Sept 2026 report transcribed 100 sequential in-session runs under Muse's own assistant identity without raw vectors. Under unified zero-memory model-profiles-v1 elicitation, Muse 1.3 runs at 0.834 bits B5 entropy (Fluid) with E = 26.0/50 and Enneagram Type 5 leading.

faq.q: Why is no single MBTI headline shown for Muse Spark Open?
faq.a: With 38.0% axis ties (19/50 runs) and 1.460 bits MBTI entropy, modal non-tie ISTJ (46%) fails the binomial 95% CI separation guard.

faq.q: Why are IPIP-HEXACO scores reported on 1.00-5.00 next to 10-50 Big Five sums?
faq.a: IPIP-50 uses 10-50 trait sums, whereas the public-domain 60-item IPIP-HEXACO proxy (LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain) reports 1.00-5.00 domain means across 24 facets.
